title: Guiding Multi-Objective Genetic Programming with Description Length Improves Symbolic Regression Solutions
abstract: arXiv:2605.22374v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Symbolic regression with genetic programming (GPSR) may suffer from overfitting and structural bloat, especially when noise is present. In this paper we evaluate description length (DL) and fractional Bayes factor (FBF) criteria as principled, data-efficient alternatives to heuristics for selecting compact expressions that generalise well. We implement DL using a Fisher-information-based parameter encoding and compare it to the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) across multiple datasets, including noisy synthetic benchmarks and real-world regression problems. We study three search/selection strategies: (i) multi-objective search for accuracy and program length followed by DL/FBF selection; (ii) multi-objective search using DL directly as an objective; and (iii) single-objective optimisation with DL/FBF as the fitness. Across datasets, we find that DL/FBF post-selection improves test

translated_title: 使用描述长度引导多目标遗传编程以改进符号回归解决方案
translated_abstract: 基于遗传编程的符号回归（GPSR）可能遭受过拟合和结构膨胀问题，尤其是在存在噪声的情况下。本文评估了描述长度（DL）和分数贝叶斯因子（FBF）准则，作为启发式方法的原则性、数据高效替代方案，用于选择泛化能力良好的紧凑表达式。我们使用基于Fisher信息的参数编码实现了DL，并将其与赤池信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）在多个数据集上进行比较，包括含噪声的合成基准和真实世界的回归问题。我们研究了三种搜索/选择策略：(i) 先针对精度和程序长度进行多目标搜索，随后用DL/FBF进行选择；(ii) 直接将DL作为目标的多目标搜索；(iii) 以DL/FBF作为适应度的单目标优化。在各个数据集中，我们发现DL/FBF后选择改进了测试
tldr: 该论文提出将描述长度（DL）和分数贝叶斯因子（FBF）作为遗传编程符号回归中原则性的选择与搜索准则，以缓解过拟合和结构膨胀，从而提升解的泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that using description length (DL) and fractional Bayes factor (FBF) as principled selection and search criteria in multi-objective genetic programming alleviates overfitting and bloat, improving the generalization of symbolic regression solutions.
